feeds.title: US Squash
feeds.description: US Squash is the national governing body and membership organization for the sport of squash in the United States. US Squash's vision is for all people to have the opportunity to enhance their health and well being through the sport of squash.

feeds.title: Squash Mad
feeds.description: Squash Mad is the number one resource for exclusive interviews, breaking news, and hard-hitting opinions. The site was first founded by Alan Thatcher, who gave a unique and much-needed voice to a sport that is now vastly under-represented in the media. Since 2022, Squash Mad has been owned by 1Touch Media, which also publishes The Hockey Paper and The Padel Paper.

feeds.title: SquashSite
feeds.description: All about squash - news, results and more from PSA, WSF, and more squash tournaments worldwide

feeds.title: World Squash Federation
feeds.description: The WSF is recognised by the International Olympic Committee as the International Federation for squash. It is a member of the General Association of International Sports Federations & the Association of the IOC Recognised International Sports Federation. Follow to get up-to-the-minute world squash news.

feeds.title: Control the 'T' Sports Blog
feeds.description: Squash blog, news, articles and tips from Control the ' 'T ' Sports - The Squash Source

feeds.title: Squash Canada
feeds.description: Squash Canada provides a high performance system for athletes, coaches and officials, and sets standards for squash in Canada. Squash Canada sets and maintains standards for the training and certification of coaches and officials in the sport of squash.

feeds.title: Northumbria Squash
feeds.description: All about Northumbria Squash.

feeds.title: Squash Racquets Association of Malaysia
feeds.description: The Squash Racquets Association of Malaysia, is the official Malaysian Squash association featuring all about Squash in Malaysia.

feeds.title: Interactive Squash Blog
feeds.description: Interactive Squash is bringing the game of Squash to the 21st century. The fully interactive court can be used to enhance skills and attract new audiences. iSquash is a project created, developed and owned by FUN WITH BALLS GmbH. This Munich-based firm develops software and hardware for augmented reality sports applications.

feeds.title: East Coast Squash Academy Blog
feeds.description: Give athletes the opportunity to reach their full potential, turn junior squash players into professional squash players and give the pathway to become international players. Gives opportunities to children to represent at regional, state, national and international level.

feeds.title: SeriousSquash
feeds.description: SeriousSquash by Chris Hanebury is all about tips on how to improve the squash game and cover many topics of squash, including articles for parents and coaches. Serious Squash is also about his journey on becoming the best, he possibly can and not settling for the status quo.

feeds.title: Squashpoint Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated with the latest Squash racket reviews, product comparison, tips and tricks to improve your game, inspiring interviews, videos, and lots more.

feeds.title: Indian Sports News
feeds.description: Latest updated news on International Squash from Indian Sports News.

feeds.title: Harvard Squash
feeds.description: The Official Site of Harvard Men's and Women's Squash.

feeds.title: Double Dot Squash
feeds.description: Double Dot Squash provides enjoyment and athletic and life skills through squash to help you achieve your squash goals and enhance your overall lifestyle. It deliver an enjoyable and comprehensive squash programme and services for all. It have a progress plan and pathway in place for every squash player, whether you want to compete at the highest level, or play squash as a social sport.

feeds.title: Norcal Squash
feeds.description: Northern California Squash Association is an organization committed to providing support and organization for squash players in Northern California. It is owned by the entity known as the 'San Francisco International Squash Federation', SFISF. SFISF is a registered charitable corporation with 501 C(3) designation.

feeds.title: Kim Are Killingberg Squash blog
feeds.description: A Squash blog authored by Kim Killingberg sharing his Squash life, Performences and achievements.

feeds.title: West Squash
feeds.description: West Squash and Racketball is an association of Squash Clubs in Glasgow and the West of Scotland. It is the Affiliated Regional Association of Scottish Squash representing these clubs. The Association's purpose is to encourage the game of squash in the west of Scotland through as many different means as possible.

feeds.title: Squash Mechanics
feeds.description: Squash Mechanics are an innovative consulting team equipped with proven solutions to Sports Business Management.

feeds.title: Windsor Squash & Fitness
feeds.description: The aim of the program is to introduce as many young people to the game of squash as possible.

feeds.title: Harrow - Squash
feeds.description: Harrow Sports manufactures Lacrosse, Hockey, Field Hockey, Squash, Racquet Sports, Custom Gear and Apparel. Harrow's goal is to provide superior customer service, fast turnaround time, and unique solutions for the specific needs of each athlete. It constantly exploring innovative options to provide athletes with equipment that will allow them to perform at the highest level.

feeds.title: Cyrus Poncha's squash blog
feeds.description: Cyrus Poncha National Coach at Squash Rackets Federation of India writes all about Squash & sports news.

feeds.title: Squash Source Blog
feeds.description: A resource for squash gear reviews, squash equipment news, and general information about the sport of squash. Authored by Pierre Bastien.

feeds.title: Cross Courts Squash

feeds.title: MSquash Blog
feeds.description: MSquash is a High Performance Squash Academy based in New York. Shaun Moxham and Katline Cauwels offer top level squash camps, squash clinics, squash lessons.

feeds.title: Toronto & District Women's Squash Association Blog
feeds.description: The Toronto and District Women's Squash Association (TDWSA) is the premier singles league serving T&D's vibrant and diverse women's squash community. It offers a competitive team-based singles squash league experience with weekly play and a social component for women of all ages and levels of play.
